title: Beware of Dieting
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Ran, Sonoko, Inspector Chiba) omitted by convention, matching ep011. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. Cookie the studio dog is modeled as an `object` node (role: evidence) rather than a `person`, since she is an animal, not a named human character -- but she is load-bearing to the plot as the unwitting carrier of the poisoned wrap, so she is kept as a node rather than folded into an attr. Old cases/ep635 summary is largely accurate on the culprit and core mechanism (Satoyama, poisoned plastic wrap, dog hiding the evidence, revenge for her parents' suicide) but collapsed the plot to 3 skeletal events and 1 clue: it omitted the moonlight-yoga lure (needed to get Degawa's dinner into her room unsupervised), the wrap-swap sleight-of-hand (removing the roll without disturbing the torn strip via the box's side tab), the two red herrings' independent motives (Kaoru was fired from a prior job over one of Degawa's complaints; Yasuko secretly loathed Degawa despite posing as her friend and was seen trampling her clothes), and the locked-room key-accounting clue that clears Yasuko. case_type: murder.

attrs.family: daughter of the Degawa Corporation president
attrs.reputation: notorious complainer; sued by multiple people; lost a lawsuit the afternoon she died

attrs.circumstance: fell into debt and shut down after Degawa's complaint 3 years earlier, then died by suicide

attrs.trick: cyanide painted on a wrap segment, dried, rerolled; swapped in without disturbing the torn starter strip via the box's side tab
attrs.triggered_by: steam condensation while microwaving dripped the poison into the food

attrs.planted_to: stage the death as a suicide

attrs.note: unwittingly carried the used poisoned wrap hidden in her pocket by Satoyama; her agitation at the smell foiled disposal, so it was found and became evidence

clues.desc: Yellow Queen-of-the-Night pollen absent on Kaoru's shoulder before she left for the patch, present after she returned -- confirms she genuinely went there, clearing her.
No used plastic wrap turned up in the trash despite Degawa microwaving her food -- the wrap she used had been swapped out beforehand.
Both room keys (one in Degawa's pocket, the spare in the safe) were accounted for -- no one could have locked the door from outside, clearing Yasuko.

edges.method: opened the box's side tab to swap in the pre-poisoned roll without disturbing the torn starter strip
cyanide-laced plastic wrap dripped into her food when microwaved
